openings.claim: Pencilled pattern quantities, marked only after filling, extend existing tray/sample guidance and move checking into assembly.
openings.discriminator: Quantity confusion predicts fewer shared-material omissions; interference predicts local materials outperform correctly used shared-tray checks.
openings.probe: Compare incumbent, shared trays/checklists, and local materials without checklists in matched-mixture, alternating-order batches; count contents and total preparation/checking time.
openings.uncertainty: Exact quantities must be available; small-batch success does not establish full-run feasibility or resilience to supply depletion.

openings.claim: Exterior pattern names expose kit identity; verify contents against names before closure.
openings.discriminator: Correct, legible, consulted names should remove identity-related exchanges; assignment or contents mismatches may persist.
openings.probe: Include naming/verification time; tally exchanges and compare recipient assignment, name, and contents.
openings.uncertainty: Recipient assignments must be accessible; completeness and deadline remain separate, unproven requirements.

openings.claim: Separate local small batches may reduce picking interference; A1 adds pre-counting and sample checks, whereas Z1's rival uses loose materials without checklists.
openings.discriminator: Matched mixture separates interference from easier patterns; fewer crossings without improved omissions/time defeats A1's advantage.
openings.probe: Measure staged area, crossings, picking discrepancies before filling, filling discrepancies before closure, and checked elapsed time; preserve the distinction between local variants.
openings.uncertainty: Local space and comparison-plus-completion time are unconfirmed; O4's mixture and omission stage are unknown.

lineage.reason: Retains quantity guidance, naming, and local-material rival explicitly.
Preserves pre-counted local batching and staged error diagnosis.

decision: Probe these synthetic hypotheses under exact quantities/dimensions, exactly two volunteers, at most 90 minutes, the existing 180-by-75-centimetre table, and existing envelopes/supplies only: no equipment or purchases. Reserve completion/checking time. Success requires all 60 kits ready with at most one distribution correction; no supplied intervention proves this.
